// diagnostic

E0029

Two access markers on one parameter (D-CAP7/D-MEM1)

What

Two access markers on one parameter (D-CAP7/D-MEM1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Keep exactly one access marker on the parameter.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0029: tests/ui/two_access_markers_on_a_value.stderr.

Error [E0029]: This value has two access markers
  --> tests/ui/two_access_markers_on_a_value.jet:5:11
    |
  5 |     print(^^handle.join() ?? 0)
    |           ^^
 Why: A value takes one access marker: `&` to write the place or `^` to move it
 Fix: Keep one marker and remove the other
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0029
